title: Profile: Static export
summary: Download a static ZIP of your public author space.

sections.title: What is included
sections.markdown: Static export creates a ZIP of your published author-space pages and referenced local public assets. Drafts, private account data, admin routes, users, config, runtime files, and other authors are not included.

sections.title: Canonical base URL
sections.markdown: This optional field is for canonical and social metadata only. Use a full URL such as `https://example.com/exported_site` if the exported copy will live there. Links and assets inside the ZIP remain relative, so the ZIP can still be moved as a folder.

sections.title: Archive lifetime
sections.markdown: Generated ZIP files are stored privately and expire after 6 hours. Only your account can download or delete your author-space exports; superadmins can manage site-level exports.

sections.title: Static limits
sections.markdown: A static export cannot run PHP, login sessions, forms, provider refreshes, admin routes, or other live server behavior. Dynamic public output is captured as it rendered at export time.
